{{Top}}
The '''silk of the umbraspider''' was used to create [[Sakiyan shadowsuit/Legends|Sakiyan shadowsuits]]. Although most [[shadowsuit]]s made use of [[Shadowsilk/Legends|shadowsilk]] to hide the wearer, the [[Sakiyan/Legends|Sakiyans]] maintained that umbraspider silk was superior.<ref name="LoNH">''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''</ref>
